title: First Congregational Parsonage, 305 West Second Street, Wabasha, Wabasha County, MN
notes: Significance: One of Wabasha's finest examples of a frame Italianate style building.  Its exterior integrity has survived throughout its service as the First Congregational Parsonage from 1872 to 1955, as a residence from 1955 to 1979, and as a chiropractic clinic from 1979 to 1986.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 82003063
